### Executive Summary
A cybersecurity report published by Zscaler reveals that threat actors are increasingly leveraging artificial intelligence to execute ransomware attacks. These AI-assisted campaigns are contributing to massive data theft across target organizations.

The financial toll of these operations remains substantial, with the report identifying $328 million in extortion payments driven by these heightened ransomware activities.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
AI-assisted ransomware operations allow threat actors to optimize attack vectors and scale data exfiltration efforts. The deployment of AI tools assists adversaries in facilitating rapid intrusion cycles and maximizing operational impact.
